'''Paul Tyler Feldman''' (also listed as '''Tyler Feldman''') is the son of [[Paul Todd Feldman]] and a player in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]].<ref name="p1421353">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1421353#p1421353 Re: Event #1 - 2024 Retro GEMP League - P-Hoth Constructed], Leverandon (Steve Sanders), forum.starwarsccg.org (19 February 2024): "We've got the father and son duo of Paul Todd Feldman and Paul Tyler Feldman playing in the league again this year." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012162727/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84003.html Internet Archive].</ref>
